svg.aria-label: ONE SOURCE: Every API and every event is defined here first. Services follow the contract. GENERATED CLIENTS: Go (oapi-codegen) and TypeScript (openapi-fetch). CI fails when they drift. BREAKING = RED: oasdiff and eventcompat fail a PR that renames or removes a field
